verdict.rationale: Name.com documents API primitives: an API, SDKs, webhook subscriptions and an MCP server that lets agents call the API on request. These are developer building blocks for constructing automations, not a product feature for defining automations that run autonomously in the background. The auto-renew setting is a single fixed domain toggle, an adjacent control rather than user-configurable background automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
